EXTRA CLASSES

The bonus shelf of the school.

Two extra classes sit beside the core learning path — never inside it: the regular classes stay the main sequence, and these are a bonus for families who want more. Skip them freely: no one falls behind.

Two bonus classes sit beside the core learning path — never inside it. The regular classes stay the main sequence; the extras are a bonus shelf for families who want more. Skip them freely: no one falls behind.

EXTRA CLASS

The Toddler Room

Thirty-five cards for one- to three-year-olds: the toys, the mealtimes, the sleep corner and the care routines of the toddler room, each with an age pill and its own lesson.

Visit the Toddler Room ↗EXTRA CLASS

Kitchen Helper

Thirty-five kitchen cards with age pills — everyday things, helper tools, grown-up tools and the one rule card: knives are for grown-ups. Lessons teach the hot-don’t-touch crew too.

Visit the Kitchen ↗

Every extra class keeps its own card set in the flashcards library — the Toddler Room cards on the toddler shelf, the Kitchen cards on the Ages 4–5 shelf — and every card opens its own lesson inside the class. The core Learning Path runs its own sequence, untouched.
